_README: Which jobs form which dataset. Literal, because job IDs are one global counter on a queue shared by every user -- users interleave by design, so a numeric range is not an identifier. Resolved once from jobs.db by owner, program class, COMPLETED status and config-triple agreement; the resolver was a throwaway and is not kept. Interim home: this belongs in the aggregate HDF5 manifest (spec 3.3) once aggregates can save.
